topics.title: Start
topics.teach: The pre-check asks what you think before the teaching. The official questions stay on the assessment, not on this page.

fields.label: I am ready for the pre-check

topics.title: Heart
topics.teach: Name one traditional food that supports health and one practice that gets people moving. Pulse, breathing, and body temperature are vital signs.

topics.title: Method
topics.teach: The if-then sentence is a hypothesis. Name the activity you will change and the signal you will measure.

fields.name: kind
fields.label: What kind of sentence is the if-then?

topics.title: Rest
topics.teach: Count beats for 15 seconds and breaths for one quiet minute. The wrist is the method in this lesson.

topics.title: Move
topics.teach: Choose march in place, or lift a book if you should not march. Record the standing counts and the counts right after two minutes.

fields.name: move_breaths
fields.label: Breaths in one minute after moving

fields.name: stopped
fields.label: If you did not do an extra minute, say why

topics.title: Data
topics.teach: Say whether your heart rate rose, stayed, or fell. Repeated calm mornings tell you more than one count while talking.

fields.name: error
fields.label: One mistake that could change a number

topics.title: Community
topics.teach: Say what you would do if a number stayed far from your usual baseline, and name one community condition.

fields.name: note
fields.label: Two sentences your family could use

topics.title: Wrap
topics.teach: Write the question your experiment asked, what you measured, and what the numbers did.
